results.text: Diuretic resistance and the efficacy of hydrochlorothiazide in acute decompensated heart failure: A post-hoc analysis of the CLOROTIC trial. Diuretic resistance (DR) in acute decompensated heart failure (ADHF) is associated with poor outcomes. The CLOROTIC trial demonstrated hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ) with intravenous furosemide improved weight loss in ADHF. Comparison of Cardiovascular Outcomes Between Chlorthalidone and Hydrochlorothiazide in Hypertensive Patients. Chlorthalidone (CLTD) and hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ) are widely used thiazide diuretics for hypertension management. This study aimed to evaluate and compare the cardiovascular outcomes of patients treated with CLTD versus HCTZ.
